meta.title: BioSense — Next-Generation Biosensing Technology
meta.description: BioSense is developing a new multi-parameter biosensing platform exploring continuous glucose, tissue oxygen and temperature sensing.
meta.ogDescription: A multi-parameter biosensing platform in research and development. Not a medical device.

hero.body: Multi-parameter biosensing, being developed to explore a more continuous view of human biology.
hero.disclaimer: BioSense is an experimental technology platform in development. It is not currently a medical device and is not intended for diagnosis or treatment.

window.title: A new window into the body.
window.p1: Most of what happens inside the human body remains invisible until we stop, test, measure or feel that something has changed.
window.p2: BioSense is exploring a different future: one where important biological signals could be observed more continuously, creating a richer picture of how the body changes over time.

glucose.title: Glucose dynamics
glucose.body: BioSense is exploring electrochemical glucose sensing designed to observe glucose-related changes in interstitial fluid.

oxygen.title: Tissue oxygen
oxygen.body: An independent electrochemical sensing channel is being researched to study local tissue oxygen-related signals.

temperature.title: Local temperature
temperature.body: A dedicated temperature channel is being developed to observe local thermal changes and support future multi-signal interpretation.

sensor.label: Implant concept
sensor.body: A small passive or near-passive subcutaneous sensing module designed around extremely low-power electronics.

band.label: BioBand
band.body: The external wearable is designed to power, communicate with and collect information from the sensor while connecting the system to the smartphone.

app.label: App
app.body: Software is envisioned as the layer that turns raw signals into understandable trends and context.

insight.label: Insight
insight.body: The long-term aim is meaning — not a stream of unexplained numbers.

wireless.title: No battery inside the sensor.
wireless.p1: The current BioSense architecture explores wireless power transfer between BioBand and the subcutaneous module.
wireless.p2: The goal is to keep the implanted electronics extremely small while moving the rechargeable battery, Bluetooth radio and larger power system into the wearable.
wireless.sensorItems: Sensor electronics · Electrochemical AFE · MCU · Small coil
wireless.note: Concept architecture. Final implementation may evolve during engineering development.

continuity.title: Health is not a snapshot.
continuity.p2: BioSense is being developed around the idea that understanding trends may be more useful than seeing isolated measurements.

insight.title: Data is only useful when it becomes understanding.
insight.p1: BioSense is not being designed simply to generate more numbers.
insight.p2: The long-term software vision is to combine multiple signals, history and context so that biological data becomes easier to understand.

benefits.title: What could continuous insight unlock?
benefits.disclaimer: These represent research directions and long-term possibilities, not currently validated medical functions.

awareness.title: Body awareness
awareness.body: See patterns that may otherwise remain invisible.

nutrition.title: Nutrition context
nutrition.body: Explore how biological signals change around meals.

activity.title: Activity
activity.body: Observe how the body responds to movement and recovery.

trends.title: Long-term trends
trends.body: Understand changes across days, weeks and months.

personal.title: Personalization
personal.body: Build a picture centered on the individual rather than population averages alone.

research.title: Research
research.body: Create new opportunities to study relationships between biological signals.

development.title: Engineering before promises.
development.body: BioSense is being developed step by step. Before making claims about what the technology can do, we are building models, simulations, electronics, sensing architectures and validation methods.
development.disclaimer: BioSense is an experimental research and development project. Concepts, specifications, features, dimensions and capabilities shown on this website may change. BioSense is not currently an approved medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent disease.

engineering.title: A serious architecture, still being evaluated.
engineering.lead: The signal path under study is electrochemical sensing, analog front-end, conversion, low-power processing, inductive coupling, BioBand, then software.
engineering.aducm: An ADuCM355-class electrochemical MCU/AFE is currently being evaluated. Architecture may change.

physical.title: Designed to disappear into everyday life.
physical.body: The design direction is small, smooth, rounded and low-profile. No sharp geometry. An RF-transparent outer structure. An external wearable aligned above it.
physical.materials: Materials and final dimensions remain under engineering evaluation.
physical.dims: 15–25 mm length · 4–7 mm width · 2–4 mm thickness
physical.change: Dimensions are conceptual and may change substantially.

underskin.title: Designed to sit quietly under the surface.
underskin.body: A conceptual view of how a small sensing module could sit beneath the skin, aligned with BioBand above.
underskin.label: Concept visualization

responsible.title: Building carefully matters.
responsible.body: Implantable sensing technology requires far more than electronics. Long-term stability, biological response, sterilization, materials and rigorous validation are central engineering challenges for BioSense.
responsible.items: Biocompatibility · sensor stability · foreign-body response · biofouling · sterilization · drift · wireless power safety · validation · regulatory pathways

vision.title: Technology should help people understand themselves.
vision.line: Give people a clearer relationship with their own biology.
vision.not3: Not another screen full of meaningless numbers.

partners.title: BioSense is bigger than one discipline.

investors.title: Interested in the future of biosensing?
investors.body: BioSense welcomes conversations with researchers, technology partners, manufacturers and strategic collaborators interested in advancing next-generation biosensing.

waitlist.title: Follow the journey.
waitlist.body: BioSense is still being built. Join the development list to receive major project updates, prototype milestones and future availability information.
waitlist.consent: I understand BioSense is currently an experimental technology under development.
waitlist.successBody: We’ll write when there is a real milestone to share.

what.a: BioSense is a research and development project exploring a future multi-parameter biosensing platform combining a small subcutaneous sensing module, an external wearable and software.

available.a: No. BioSense is currently under development and is not commercially available.

device.a: No. The current BioSense prototype and research platform is not an approved medical device and is not intended for diagnosis or treatment.

measure.q: What is BioSense designed to measure?
measure.a: Current research focuses on glucose-related electrochemical signals, tissue oxygen-related electrochemical signals and local temperature.

battery.q: Does the implant contain a battery?
battery.a: The current architecture explores a passive or near-passive implant powered wirelessly by the external BioBand. Final architecture may evolve during development.

spo2.q: Does BioSense measure blood oxygen or SpO₂?
spo2.a: No. The current oxygen research channel is an experimental electrochemical tissue-sensing concept and should not be interpreted as pulse-oximeter SpO₂.

stage.a: BioSense is currently in engineering, simulation and early architecture development. Bench validation and physical prototypes remain part of the development roadmap.

collaborate.a: Yes. BioSense welcomes serious conversations with researchers, engineers, laboratories, manufacturers and strategic technology partners.

footer.disclaimer: BioSense is an experimental research and development project. Concepts, specifications, features, dimensions and capabilities shown on this website may change. BioSense is not currently an approved medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent disease.
